verdict.rationale: Postman ships in-product AI. Agent Mode can fix errors, update tests, visualize responses and write documentation from natural language, and Postbot is available on all plans with usage caps. However, the docs describe action-oriented assistance rather than explicit insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data, so the analysis part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data (e.g., response or analytics analysis), detail on what Postbot does, and independent or hands-on corroboration; Postbot's 50-activity monthly cap is also a limit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: With Agent Mode, you can turn your words into action across the API lifecycle. Send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, using natural language.
You can ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests, visualize responses, write documentation, and more.
Postbot is free to try on all Postman plans . Monthly usage is limited to 50 activities per user.
